descriptionChirho: Deliberate deception or treachery; craftiness employed to mislead or harm another person. All occurrences share the same semantic content, with the dative/instrumental forms ('by deceit') expressing the means rather than a different meaning. Spanish 'engano/con engano,' Hindi 'chhal/chhal se,' Arabic 'makr/bi-makr,' Korean 'sokimsu/sokimsuro,' Swahili 'udanganyifu/hila/kwa hila.' Found in vice lists (Mark 7:22; Rom 1:29; 1 Pet 2:1), descriptions of the guiltless (John 1:47; 1 Pet 2:22), and accounts of deceptive schemes (Matt 26:4; Acts 13:10; 2 Cor 12:16).
